title.narrative: Addressing health system-related challenges in TB care in Romania

description.narrative: Romania - Tuberculosis - Ministry of Health of Romania - MOH. This program has the following goals: Addressing health system-related challenges in TB care in Romania. The objectives of this program are: Strengthening the country's capacity to develop and implement national health strategies, disease-specific strategic plans and national public health programs (NPHP), including NTP at MoH level. Protect and promote human rights, ethics and equity in accessing the basic medical services. Improving service delivery through evidence-based clinical and managerial decisions and sustainable infrastructure. Improving treatment outcomes in the most vulnerable, underserved, at-risk population. Strengthen community responses, systems and commitment for disease control
